concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-reporting-invoice-reconciliation]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen guide to matching Payment accounting report transaction costs against a monthly Payment processing invoice, with an exact CET month window, distinct processing/acquiring fee comparisons, rounding caveat, and next-payout invoice-deduction route; it does not prove bank receipt or accounting finality.
warnings: Keep this invoice reconciliation procedure distinct from the Payment accounting report field reference and the monthly invoice itself.
